workstreams.name: Branch rollout
workstreams.answers: In what order do the 120 branches move onto the new branch operating model, and when is each live?
activities: Agree wave sequence and readiness checks for each branch
Launch the model wave by wave after the readiness review
Collect issues from branch staff and managers at each wave

workstreams.name: Staff training
workstreams.answers: How do branch staff get ready to work in the new model before their branch goes live?
activities: Prepare training content for each role in the new model
Train branch staff in each wave ahead of go-live
Coach staff after go-live using feedback from branch teams

workstreams.name: Performance tracking
workstreams.answers: Which measures show a branch is running the new model, and how do branches perform as each goes live?
activities: Define the measures that show a branch runs the new model
Track each wave on those measures using operational data
Check in branches that work follows the new model
